baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first negation joins a denied decisive act to death, while the second independently denies any reduction of the punishment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse closes both ways in which the condition could change: decisive completion through death and quantitative modulation through relief. Continued existence is therefore structured as non-termination plus non-reduction, not merely as a long duration.

activation_trace.role: The root's death-enacting verdict sense supplies the terminal event explicitly blocked by the first negation.
Its completion and expiry sense broadens the denied event from dying to reaching an endpoint at all.
Loss of life is the unavailable terminal release rather than the punishment's ordinary result.
Lightening a weight supplies the second possible state-change, whose negation leaves the load undiminished.
Severe painful punishment identifies what persists when neither endpoint nor easing is admitted.

changed_reading.before: The verse says that the punishment lasts forever.
changed_reading.after: The verse designs a suspended condition with two separately barred transitions: it cannot complete in death and cannot vary downward in intensity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated unbelief root encloses the fire clause and returns in the final universal object of recompense.
baseline_models.mechanism: A covering or concealment action is answered by a fire-root whose inventory also carries illumination and visible marking. The focus can therefore hold an exposure reversal: what was covered is met by a medium that both burns and makes manifest.

activation_trace.role: Literal covering supplies the action that the fire can reverse by disclosure.
Concealment or rejection of truth keeps the covering image anchored in the verse's human designation.
Actual burning fire supplies the punitive medium and its agitated visible action.
The same inventory's illumination sense lets the fire function as exposure without replacing its literal heat.

changed_reading.before: Fire is only the instrument that burns the unbelievers.
changed_reading.after: Fire remains literal punishment but also reverses concealment, forcing visibility where truth or benefit had been covered.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The concluding comparison joins recompense to every emphatically characterized ingrate, while the same root also opens the verse.
baseline_models.mechanism: The closing clause turns the preceding no-exit mechanism into a rule of responsive consequence. Comprehensive scope and repeated ingratitude make the case neither accidental nor merely collective: each complete instance of the stance falls under the response.

activation_trace.role: Countering an act with its consequence supplies the responsive link between the stance and the described condition.
Comprehensive inclusion distributes the rule across the whole class without leaving an unaddressed part.
Denial of benefit or failure to acknowledge it specifies the recurring disposition answered by the recompense.

changed_reading.before: A named group receives a generic sentence.
changed_reading.after: The no-exit condition is presented as a comprehensive response to each fully formed instance of unacknowledged benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier opening-and-holding pair describes controlled access to mercy: what is opened cannot be detained, and what is detained cannot be sent onward. Against that system, the focus occupies a release-disabled state in which neither the terminal channel of death nor the lesser channel of easing opens.

activation_trace.role: Completion is the focus's blocked terminal channel.
Reduction of a load is the focus's blocked partial-release channel.
An opened closure and widened entry supply the positive gate operation against which the focus reads as shut.
Tender mercy identifies what flows through the open side of the control pair.
Holding and confining supply the opposing operation and make continued detention a live mechanism.
Sending onward supplies the release operation absent from the focus condition.

structural_cues: 35:2 and 35:36 both use paired clauses to exhaust complementary control possibilities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, detention, and dispatch; I treat death and easing as two release channels. A live alternative is a simpler moral contrast between mercy and punishment without a shared gate mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The two negations merely intensify duration and pain.
changed_reading.after: The two negations specify a controlled detention in which both full release and partial relief are disabled.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elsewhere in the packet, death is a hinge in a dead-earth-to-life sequence, moving things run toward an appointed limit, and worldly people are deferred only until their term. The focus's denied death can therefore mean more than endless biological survival: the normal hinge into another phase is withheld after the ordinary clock has already done its work.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life is the focus transition explicitly made unavailable.
Lifeless land supplies a material death-state that is subsequently crossed rather than treated as a final stop.
Earth restored by rain supplies the next phase on the far side of the death-state.
Revival after death makes the transition model explicit rather than merely botanical.
Continuous running supplies ordinary movement toward a temporal boundary.
A fixed terminal time supplies the normal goal toward which the running proceeds.
Deferral to a later time distinguishes temporary worldly postponement from the focus's post-term non-completion.
The twice-marked term confirms that ordinary delay still reaches a boundary, sharpening the focus's missing endpoint.

structural_cues: The packet uses the same analogical formula after revived land and after the focus punishment, inviting comparison of two opposite transition patterns.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversible death, goal-directed time, and bounded deferral; I infer that denied death withholds a phase transition. The live alternative is that these passages establish duration only, without making death itself a beneficial hinge.

changed_reading.before: Not dying means simply remaining alive under punishment.
changed_reading.after: Not dying also means being denied the transition that death elsewhere mediates, in a condition no longer moving toward an appointed endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier burden rule denies transfer even when a heavily loaded person calls for help. That exact heavy-versus-light field changes the focus's non-lightening into personal non-delegability: the recompensed load cannot be shifted, shared, or carried away by another.

activation_trace.role: Lightness opposed to weight makes relief measurable as removal of load.
Act-responsive recompense attaches the unreduced load to the conduct it answers.
Comprehensive scope applies the non-transfer rule to each member covered by the closing clause.
A personally borne heavy load supplies the object that another bearer cannot remove.
Weight as the direct opposite of lightness locks the earlier burden clause to the focus's relief verb.
Bearing responsibility or burden supplies the attempted transfer that the packet explicitly refuses.

structural_cues: 35:18 says that none of the called person's load is carried away, while 35:36 says none of the punishment is lightened away from them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a non-transferable heavy load and the focus supplies non-lightening; I map the legal burden rule onto punishment relief. The alternative is that 35:18 concerns responsibility before judgment and does not describe the later experience.

changed_reading.before: No lightening means only that the intensity remains high.
changed_reading.after: No lightening also means that each person's consequence is non-transferable: no other bearer can take off even part of the load.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet moves from beautified wrongdoing mis-seen as good, through the contrast of darkness and light, to an illuminating book followed by the taking of those who rejected. This sequence strengthens the focus fire as belated clarification: the same root field that provides literal flame now makes prior concealment and distorted seeing impossible.

activation_trace.role: Rejection or concealment of truth supplies the epistemic condition reversed by exposure.
Literal flame keeps the exposure model anchored in the actual focus punishment.
Making something appear attractive supplies the cosmetic layer that distorts judgment.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the faculty whose evaluation has been misdirected.
Illumination set against darkness makes disclosure a packet-level contrast, not a focus-only wordplay.
The illuminating book supplies an earlier, non-punitive opportunity for clarification.
Rejection immediately after the illuminating book connects refused clarification to the focus's later fiery clarification.

structural_cues: The visual sequence runs from mis-seeing, to darkness/light, to an illuminating book, to rejection, and finally to fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distorted seeing, light, an illuminating book, rejection, and literal fire; I infer that the fire functions as forced disclosure. The alternative is that the shared root field is incidental and the fire has no epistemic role.

changed_reading.before: The fire only inflicts bodily pain after rejection.
changed_reading.after: The fire also becomes a terminal mode of seeing: refused illumination returns as inescapable exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet describes favorable response as full payment without deficiency and then an added gift, while repeatedly characterizing the giver through appreciative return. The focus answers the opposite disposition with recompense that is not reduced. The economy is responsive but not flatly symmetrical: acknowledgment receives completion plus surplus, whereas ingratitude receives an unreduced consequence.

activation_trace.role: Response to an act provides the common accounting relation across favorable and punitive outcomes.
Reduction in amount is explicitly denied on the punitive side of the comparison.
Failure to acknowledge benefit identifies the stance answered on the punitive side.
Full completion without deficiency supplies the baseline favorable payment.
Growth beyond the completed amount supplies the favorable surplus absent from the punitive side.
Gift or beneficence marks the increase as generosity rather than a debt mechanically owed.
Acknowledging benefit supplies the positive response pole against the focus's ingratitude pole.
The immediately preceding appreciative epithet brings that positive pole next to the focus's final ingrate designation.

structural_cues: The emphatic appreciative epithet immediately before the focus is answered by the emphatic ingrate epithet at the focus close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies full payment, added gift, appreciation, ingratitude, and non-reduction; I infer a deliberately asymmetric response economy. The alternative is that the favorable surplus and punitive constancy are unrelated promises.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is a uniform one-for-one exchange.
changed_reading.after: Recompense is responsive but asymmetric: acknowledged benefit is met with fullness and surplus, while entrenched ingratitude is met with a consequence that receives no discount.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding residence is durable yet defined by removal of sorrow and non-contact with fatigue. The focus residence is also durable, but its durability is built by withholding terminal departure and withholding reduction. Permanence is therefore not the decisive value; what can leave, touch, or lessen within the permanent abode is.

activation_trace.role: Denied completion prevents the punitive residence from ending.
Denied lightening prevents painful weight from receding inside that residence.
Painful punishment names what remains present on the negative side of the paired residences.
Going away supplies the positive residence's removal operation.
Inner roughness from grief is the harmful state successfully removed there.
Settling in a place establishes the positive scene as a residence rather than a passing reward.
Stable staying supplies the permanence shared by the two neighboring outcomes.
Contact by an effect supplies the ingress explicitly denied to fatigue in the positive residence.
Exhausting toil supplies one harmful effect that cannot touch the positive residents.
Weakness and fatigue complete the double non-contact pattern mirrored by the focus's double negation.

structural_cues: 35:35 and 35:36 are adjacent residence descriptions, each closed by two coordinated negations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permanent settlement without harmful contact followed by fire without death or easing; I read them as deliberately paired architectures. The alternative is that adjacency contrasts outcomes generally without making their negation patterns formally reciprocal.

changed_reading.before: Paradise is permanent comfort and fire is permanent pain.
changed_reading.after: Both are durable residences, but one continually excludes harmful contact while the other continually excludes both departure and diminution; permanence itself is morally neutral until its internal traffic is specified.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet earlier associates the dead in graves with being beyond human address, but immediately after the focus the occupants remain vocally urgent, experientially responsive, and capable of requesting exit. Denied death thus preserves sentience and appeal while denying both escape and effective aid.

activation_trace.role: The unavailable loss of life leaves the occupants on the responsive side of the packet's living/dead contrast.
Painful experience is what continued responsiveness keeps perceptible.
Making another hear supplies the communicative capacity denied to the grave-side comparison.
Burial of the dead locates the packet's image of communicative unreachability.
A loud appeal for rescue demonstrates active voice and social need after death has been denied.
Passage to an outside supplies the exit they consciously request but do not receive.
Direct experiential testing confirms retained perception rather than mere biological persistence.
Aid and vindication supply the social response explicitly unavailable to their appeal.

structural_cues: 35:22 places the dead beyond address; 35:36 denies death; 35:37 immediately displays crying, requesting, and tasting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies communicative unreachability for the dead and vivid perception for the fire's occupants; I infer that denied death enforces sentience. The alternative is that the later speech and tasting are conventional scene details with no special relation to the death negation.

changed_reading.before: Not dying is only the absence of a bodily endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Not dying also preserves the very capacities by which the punishment is perceived and escape is desired: voice, experience, and unanswered appeal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context depicts created order as actively held from leaving its state and then denies both substitution and transformation in the governing pattern. Those controls sharpen the focus's double blockage into active conservation: the punishment is maintained against terminal removal and internal reduction rather than simply continuing by inertia.

activation_trace.role: Completion or expiry is the first state-change prevented in the focus.
Reduction of weight is the second state-change prevented in the focus.
Active holding and confinement supply the conserving force rather than passive duration.
Departure from a place or condition supplies the change that active holding prevents.
Substitution of one thing for another supplies a replacement route denied by the stable pattern.
Transformation away from a condition supplies the internal change route likewise denied.

structural_cues: The focus denies two state changes; 35:41 and 35:43 later pair holding against removal with no substitution and no transformation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies active cosmic holding and invariant non-substitution; I extend that control pattern to the focus's two denied transitions. The alternative is that the later verses concern cosmic order and historical regularity without describing the maintenance of punishment.

changed_reading.before: The punishment persists because nothing happens to end it.
changed_reading.after: The punishment can be read as actively conserved: removal, replacement, transformation, and quantitative easing are all controlled away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later clauses place each person's rejection upon that person, make it accumulate as loss, and state that harmful scheming descends around its own people. These cues turn the focus's assignment and recompense into a feedback enclosure: the consequence is not only externally imposed but adheres to, grows from, and closes around the stance it answers.

activation_trace.role: Entrenched non-acknowledgment supplies the stance whose effects return to its bearer.
Responsive consequence supplies the return path from conduct to condition.
Comprehensive scope closes the rule around every complete instance of the stance.
Repeated ingratitude placed upon its own bearer supplies the self-attaching part of the feedback loop.
Increase and growth make the attached consequence cumulative rather than static.
General diminution identifies the accumulating result as loss to the bearer.
Harm descending and surrounding supplies the spatial closure of the feedback mechanism.
A group defined by belonging identifies the scheme's own people as the enclosure's recipients.

structural_cues: The focus cycles through assignment to them, action upon them, no removal from them, and universal recompense; 35:39 and 35:43 make that return-to-agent pattern explicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-borne rejection, increasing loss, and harm enclosing its own people; I combine them into a feedback loop around the focus's prepositions. The alternative is that these are separate accountability formulas without a single spatial-causal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Fire is an external penalty assigned by a judge.
changed_reading.after: Fire can also be read as a self-adhering and accumulating consequence that closes around the very disposition to which it responds.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus recompense root's non-dominant cutting inventory together with the unbelief root's agricultural branch. It remains anchored in two supplied focus mappings and is made materially live by the packet's ripe-fruit cue. Downstream prose should present it only as a branch-level harvest image, never as the lexical translation of the clause or as a replacement for moral recompense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final recompense verb, the comprehensive quantifier, and the repeated unbelief root permit a secondary image of a complete harvest reaching its cutting point.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary act-responsive recompense remains the controlling sense that contains the agricultural image.
A crop or fleece reaching the time for cutting supplies the non-dominant harvest endpoint.
Covering seed in soil supplies the agricultural actor image linked to the focus designation.
Completeness makes the image a whole harvest rather than an isolated cutting.
Ripe fruit makes maturation-to-harvest a visible packet image instead of an inventory-only pun.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is only an abstract juridical return.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the comprehensive recompense also carries a harvest-at-ripeness image: the seed-covering stance reaches the point at which its grown consequence is cut.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the punishment root's neighboring sweetness, abstention, and prevention branches interact with an earlier use of the same QAC root for fresh water. It remains valid as a material analogy anchored in the focus punishment, fire, and non-lightening, with later tasting confirming experience. Downstream prose should call it an inversion of refreshment, not claim that punishment etymologically means sweet water.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The punishment noun stands beside fire and an explicit denial of relief, allowing its wider supplied branch field to model deprivation as well as inflicted pain.

activation_trace.role: Severe pain and punishment remain the direct focus sense that contains the analogy.
Prevention or weaning away supplies deprivation as one functional component of the painful condition.
The denied removal of weight makes unavailable refreshment operate as unrelieved load.
Literal fire gives the denied-refreshment image its material pressure.
Fresh pleasant water activates the positive sensory pole carried by the same supplied root inventory.
Exceptionally fresh water intensifies the refreshment pole that the focus reverses.
Easy passage through the throat makes palatability and bodily relief concrete.
Taking in liquid completes the packet's positive refreshment mechanism.
Direct experience or testing makes the later punitive condition sensory rather than merely abstract.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is only positive infliction of pain.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, punishment also appears as anti-refreshment: fire-bound experience in which sweetness, easy intake, and the easing they imply are continually withheld.

strongest_changes: The paired negations became a two-channel control mechanism barring both terminal release and partial relief.
The non-lightening became a non-transferable personal load when read against the burden rule of 35:18.
The adjacent permanent abodes became inverses: one excludes harmful contact, while the other excludes departure and diminution.
The fire acquired a plausible disclosure function through the packet's sequence of distorted seeing, light, illuminating text, rejection, and flame.
Denied death became enforced sentience and a withheld transition, not merely endless biological survival.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly changed static duration into controlled process: opening versus holding, death as a transition hinge, burden that cannot transfer, residence defined by what may enter or leave, and consequence that grows around its bearer. Split focus mappings also preserved two high-risk but anchored material images, harvest and anti-refreshment.
remaining_uncertainties: The transition-hinge model depends on carrying the dead-earth revival sequence into the post-judgment scene; duration alone remains a live reading.
The disclosure function of fire is supported by the shared root and visual sequence but may remain secondary to literal punishment.
Active conservation and self-enclosure are reader-supplied causal syntheses rather than explicit directional claims in a single clause.
The harvest and anti-refreshment readings must remain exploratory branch images and must not be rendered as lexical translations.
